items.title: Edgar Joseph Interview, 1961-08-07
items.q: He played with Old Man Robichaud. It's a lyric theater. With that violin. That old man the violin. He played with him too.

ctx.x: Yeah, I just wondered about how old he was and what period he played in then. He played with Celestan and Chris...

Yeah, he played with Pablo Celestan. Chris Kelly. He played with... Who else he played with? Old Man Robichaud at the lyrics. It's a lyric theater. That's who he's playing with. You know he had to be a musician. He played with Old Man Robichaud. It's a lyric theater. With that violin. That old man the violin. He played with him too.

Because I had just... I had someone else to service. Yeah. Because I remember that good, you see. Because I got the service. And at that time, he couldn't put off civilian clothes. He still had to do in the uniform. He couldn't see. It's not like this today. You can change the clothes. You can see where you can go. And I went... I thought I could get from... I came here. Looking around the left. My dad... I got my advice to my brother. I know where. I was in the place where... He wasn't... They run the hell out…
